Era XIII · The Civilization of the End
Once every Ender Dragon was defeated, the Builders settled in the End.
There they raised an End city upon the floating end-stone islands—
towers, corridors, treasure vaults, dry docks.
To move about the void, they invented the elytra—
harvested from the wings of the Ender Dragon,
bound with shards of end stone,
made into wings that could carry a body briefly through the air.
The End city was the Builders' masterpiece—
a whole civilization raised where gravity held no sway.
